summary: Built the UK NEST Pensions app from inception: 100K+ downloads, 10 releases, 2 associates supervised.
headline: Building the UK NEST Pensions app from the first commit
intro: Systems Engineer by grade, Mobile Application Developer by role. Client-facing, on a UK workplace pension app used by savers to check balances, track contributions and manage their accounts.

items.title: Architecture
items.text: A typed TypeScript Redux Toolkit store, RTK Query for REST APIs with caching and auth flows, React Navigation and a library of reusable components.

items.title: Platform features
items.text: FCM push notifications, deep linking, AsyncStorage offline storage and Keychain-secured tokens for financial data.

items.title: Accessibility (my idea)
items.text: Proposed and built text zoom and voice-out so older savers could use the app. Both shipped.

items.title: Under the hood
items.text: Debugged Android native modules (Kotlin/WebView) during the React Native New Architecture migration.
faster feature delivery from reusable components
fewer production defects, helped by Jest unit tests and better team testing practices
faster load time through lazy loading
reported gain in user satisfaction from the mobile-first migration I helped deliver

sections.title: Leading people
paragraphs: Reporting manager for 2 associates for nearly 2 years: assigned work, reviewed their pull requests, set goals and shaped their salary-linked annual evaluations. I also interviewed candidates and presented progress to our UK clients.

items.text: Moved to NEST Pensions as a Mobile Application Developer
Service & Commitment Award; last day of service
